verdict.rationale: Orb runs a first-party hosted MCP server that exposes 100+ API operations as tools, so users can ask an agent in plain language to investigate a bill, model a price change, or change a subscription. Scoped keys and test mode limit what those commands can touch. However, natural-language operation depends on an external agent client; no native in-product natural-language interface is documented. missing for 10: built-in natural-language/chat interface within the Orb product, hands-on or independent corroboration of the natural-language workflows, documentation of an end-to-end natural-language command experience beyond the MCP tool listing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: You can ask an agent to look into a customer's bill, check why usage isn't showing up, model a price change, or make a subscription change
It exposes 100+ Orb API operations as tools, covering customers, subscriptions, plans and prices, billable metrics, invoices, credits, alerts, licenses, event search and price evaluation
To try things out without touching live billing data, create the key in **test mode**.
